summary: Backend and frontend changes largely implement total fuel cost capture/storage and compute price-per-liter, but there are likely UI labeling/formatting mismatches with the BuildRequest and several unrelated features were added.

missing_requirements.requirement: Record Fill-Up form includes a new numeric input labeled "Total cost" (English).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows new state/validation for `totalFuelCost`, but the provided FillUpForm.tsx snippet is truncated before the JSX; the label text for the new input cannot be verified from the diff evidence.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fill-up history entries display a new field labeled "Price per liter" when total cost is available.
missing_requirements.reason: The FillUpList snippet shows the label as "Price/L" rather than "Price per liter". This does not meet the explicit label requirement as written.

missing_requirements.requirement: Displayed price per liter is formatted to a readable fixed decimal format.
missing_requirements.reason: The hook computes `pricePerLiter`, but the rendering/formatting code in FillUpList is truncated right where the value would be displayed, so fixed-decimal formatting cannot be confirmed from the diff evidence.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a backend migration module and integrated actor migration wiring.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not ask for a migration system/module; it only required old fill-ups remain readable without trapping. The diff adds a dedicated `backend/migration.mo` and migration integration in `backend/main.mo`.

hallucinated_features.description: InstallAppButton integration / PWA-related changes (manifest link + service worker registration).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not part of requested price-per-liter feature set and explicitly outside necessary dashboard changes.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (mentions InstallAppButton in AppShell/Onboarding and service worker registration in frontend/index.html)

hallucinated_features.description: Added/changed help and onboarding/dashboard styling and other UI/UX changes unrelated to recording/displaying price per liter.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest non-goal: do not redesign unrelated dashboard components beyond what is necessary. The summary indicates multiple unrelated component/style updates.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (mentions changes to HelpContent, HelpDialog, OnboardingScreen, ProfileSetupDialog, FiltersBar, Dashboard, index.css warm earth-tone OKLCH tokens, etc.)

hallucinated_features.description: Added BigInt-safe nanosecond timestamp conversion and additional sorting/NaN handling behavior in fill-up fetching.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest; it is an extra enhancement beyond cost capture and price-per-liter display.
